Technical Procedure
Introduction

This documents out lines 
 the major maintenance procedure P2, which 
 must be performed every 
 fifteen years Y15 or 
 every10,000 operations depending on conditions of use, as indicated at the 
 above titled block.

The first draft initiated by 
 eng Khaled Ibrahem Aly El Sherkawy, at new Sharkia 220kv substation and 
 approved by Sector chairman, CB put in service at April 1994, Sina Sector, 
 Canal zone.

Experience with this 
 type of circuit breaker today allows, by overhauling a few sub-assemblies, to 
 guarantee operators reliable and economical operation equivalent to new 
 circuit breakers.
 In addition, significant savings can be made by retaining existing 
 installations and equipment peripheral to the circuit breakers: e.g. civil 
 engineering, overhead line, bus bars, measurement equipment, etc.
Safety Precautions

items:
Work order must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenace staff should the suitable safety category

Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area
Wear safety helmet, shoes

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Check SF6 gas pressure 
 7 bar at 20oC, to ensure satisfactory pressure level in the compartments. 
 using SF6 
 bottle,

Analyze SF6 gas and replace 
 if necessary, to ensure correct pressure level in the compartments. 
 See figure 1

Check and overhaul Densistats. If necessary change SF6 
 gas controllers with a new electronic densistat to give better 
 stability with time,

Replace all seals, replace all arc contacts, and replace all threaded items 
 to ensure correct sealing. using sealing kit, arc 
 contact kit, and threaded fasteners kit,

Change oil and oil filter, to maintain normal pump starting cycle using oil, 
 25 liters, oil filter kit. for more details see figure 2 and paragraph of 
 starting up the hydraulic control mechanism,

Check response times and synchronization to check 
 the correct operation of circuit breaker, see paragraph of checking CB 
 operating times

Measure wear of arc contacts, to maintain performance and to 
 ensure fault current switch off

Perform 
dielectric test on the auxiliary circuits with reduced voltage applied during 1 
second to avoid disconnection of parts of the circuits,

Measure the 
resistance of the main contacts,

Measure the 
nitrogen pressure, must be included between 180+20 bars at 15 o
C and replace the accumulator of tolerance.

sections.text: Slow operations

The slow 
operations enable displacement of the mobile assembly to perform inspections 
during assembly and overhauls
Closing

The circuit 
breaker is in the open position, the hydraulic control mechanism is drained
Close valve K3

Run the pump. As 
soon as pressure reaches 40 to 80 bar, press the electromagnet of the closing 
valve : the jack slowly rise on the pump discharge rate. At the end of travel, 
the pressure quickly rises.
Stop the pump
